title: Commercial cooking appliance venting.
officialText: Commercial cooking appliances, other than those exempted by Section 501.8, shall be vented by connecting the appliance to a vent or chimney in accordance with this code and the appliance manufacturer’s instructions or the appliance shall be vented in accordance with Section 505.1.1.
